name: Umbelina Maria Azevedo — death in November 1910, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
researcher_question: When and where did Umbelina Maria Azevedo die? She was the wife of Francisco Antônio Pariz and the mother of Alice Umbelina, Antônio Francisco, Maria Glória, Florita Umbelina and Maura Umbelina, born between about 1902 and 1918, several of them in Espírito Santo.
